implemented: Added register_domain_plan_hook with a read-only context planner returning a staged replacement context.
Plan hooks commit their replacement context only when the emitted command batch is accepted.
Planner errors consume the delivered event, set FlowDispatch.error, return a rejected receipt with failed_ticket=None, and preserve the stored context.
Actor-domain carrier registration and scheduled Pause/Resume controls now accept planned hooks while legacy hooks remain excluded from controls.
Added runtime tests for planned-context commit and planner-error atomicity; retained the existing actual control-event tests.
limitations: TransitContext is not implemented or wired to TransitProgressState; route start, movement, pause/resume progress, stale-event reconciliation, and arrival are not implemented.
The packet's required C2.3.progress runtime oracle is therefore not satisfied; this partial change does not close C2.3.progress or C2.3.
No changes to ABM adapter files were needed for this DES hook slice.
C2.2 full acceptance, C2.1 runtime join, hosted gates, and parent final-head audit remain open.
